name: data-quality-check
workflow: data quality check export nulls bad dates out of range duplicate keys
description: Data-quality check of a customer master export before it is loaded: required fields, email format, signup dates, credit limit and discount ranges, status values and duplicate keys. Writes an issue list and a pass/fail report; never edits the export.

dataset.description: export file name in the input folder without .csv, e.g. customer_master_2026-11

as_of.description: signup dates after this are invalid

steps.intent: Check {dataset} is an export in the input folder and has the expected columns

script.code:
import csv, json, os, sys
dataset = PARAMS['dataset']
src = os.path.realpath(INPUT_DIRS[0])
path = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(src, dataset + '.csv'))
if os.path.dirname(path) != src or not os.path.basename(dataset) == dataset:
    print(f'refused: dataset {dataset!r} is not a file in the input folder'); sys.exit(2)
if not os.path.exists(path):
    print(f'missing: {dataset}.csv'); sys.exit(2)
need = {'customer_id', 'name', 'email', 'country', 'signup_date', 'credit_limit', 'discount_pct', 'status'}
with open(path, newline='', encoding='utf-8-sig') as f:
    r = csv.DictReader(f); rows = list(r)
missing = sorted(need - set(r.fieldnames or []))
profile = {'ok': not missing and bool(rows), 'dataset': dataset, 'rows': len(rows), 'columns': r.fieldnames, 'missing_columns': missing}
open(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f'dq_profile_{dataset}.json'), 'w').write(json.dumps(profile, indent=1))
print(json.dumps(profile))

steps.intent: Run the customer master data-quality rules on {dataset}
Write the pass/fail data-quality report for {dataset}

script.code:
import json, os
dataset = PARAMS['dataset']
s = json.load(open(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f'dq_summary_{dataset}.json')))
verdict = 'PASSED: no issues found' if s['passed'] else f"FAILED: {s['issues']} issues in {s['rows_with_issues']} of {s['rows']} rows"
lines = [f'# Data quality check: {dataset}', '', verdict, '']
lines += [f'- {rule}: {n}' for rule, n in sorted(s['by_rule'].items())]
lines += ['', f'Details: dq_issues_{dataset}.csv. The source export was not changed.']
open(os.path.join(OUTPUT_DIR, f'dq_report_{dataset}.md'), 'w', encoding='utf-8').write('\n'.join(lines))
print('\n'.join(lines))
